SELECT
  "t1"."closed_date" AS "contract__closed_date",
  "t2"."branch_name" AS "branch__branch_name",
  COUNT(*) AS "collection_action_count"
FROM "lending"."core"."collection_actions" AS "t0"
LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"
  ON "t0"."kontrak_id" = "t1"."contract_id"
LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."branches" AS "t2"
  ON "t1"."servicing_branch_id" = "t2"."branch_id"
WHERE
  "t0"."tgl_aksi" >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND "t0"."tgl_aksi" < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)
GROUP BY
  "t1"."closed_date",
  "t2"."branch_name"
ORDER BY
  "contract__closed_date",
  "branch__branch_name"
LIMIT 1000
explanation: Collection Action Count is the number of rows of Collection Action.
Collection Action Count: Collection Action rows are placed by action date (collection_action.action_date), from 2026-01-01 up to but not including 2026-07-01.

Closed date (contract.closed_date) comes from Financing Contract: for Collection Action Count, rows are joined collection_action > contract through collection_action.contract (The contract the collection activity was carried out on).

Branch name (branch.branch_name) comes from Branch: for Collection Action Count, rows are joined collection_action > contract > branch through collection_action.contract, then contract.servicing_branch (The branch that currently services and collects the contract. Changes when a customer is transferred. Used for portfolio and collection metrics).

WITH "m_collected_amount" AS (
  SELECT
    "t2"."saluran" AS "application__channel",
    "t2"."sts_putusan" AS "application__decision_status",
    SUM("t0"."principal_paid" + "t0"."interest_paid") AS "collected_amount"
  FROM "lending"."core"."payments" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."contract_id" = "t1"."contract_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."loan_applications" AS "t2"
    ON "t1"."application_id" = "t2"."appl_id"
  WHERE
    (
      NOT "t0"."is_reversed"
    )
    AND "t0"."posting_date" >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."posting_date" < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    "t2"."saluran",
    "t2"."sts_putusan"
), "m_due_amount" AS (
  SELECT
    "t2"."saluran" AS "application__channel",
    "t2"."sts_putusan" AS "application__decision_status",
    SUM("t0"."installment_amount") AS "due_amount"
  FROM "lending"."core"."installment_schedules" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."contract_id" = "t1"."contract_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."loan_applications" AS "t2"
    ON "t1"."application_id" = "t2"."appl_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."is_current"
    )
    AND "t0"."due_date" >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."due_date" < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    "t2"."saluran",
    "t2"."sts_putusan"
), "unioned" AS (
  SELECT
    "application__channel",
    "application__decision_status",
    "collected_amount",
    NULL AS "due_amount"
  FROM "m_collected_amount"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "application__channel",
    "application__decision_status",
    NULL AS "collected_amount",
    "due_amount"
  FROM "m_due_amount"
), "combined" AS (
  SELECT
    "application__channel",
    "application__decision_status",
    COALESCE(MAX("collected_amount"), 0) AS "collected_amount",
    COALESCE(MAX("due_amount"), 0) AS "due_amount"
  FROM "unioned"
  GROUP BY
    "application__channel",
    "application__decision_status"
)
SELECT
  "application__channel",
  "application__decision_status",
  "collected_amount",
  "due_amount",
  CAST("collected_amount" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF("due_amount", 0) AS "collection_rate"
FROM "combined"
ORDER BY
  "application__channel",
  "application__decision_status"
LIMIT 1000
explanation: Collection Rate = Amount Collected divided by Amount Due. Each side is calculated separately and then combined by channel and decision status; a zero denominator gives no value (empty), not an error.
Amount Collected: Payment rows are placed by posting date (payment.posting_date), from 2025-01-01 up to but not including 2026-07-01.
Amount Due: Scheduled Installment rows are placed by due date (installment.due_date), from 2025-01-01 up to but not including 2026-07-01.
Amount Collected: only rows where NOT is_reversed count (part of the measure definition).
Amount Due: only rows where is_current count (part of the measure definition).

Channel (application.channel) and decision status (application.decision_status) come from Loan Application: for Amount Collected, rows are joined payment > contract > application through payment.contract, then contract.application (The approved application that led to this contract).

Channel (application.channel) and decision status (application.decision_status) come from Loan Application: for Amount Due, rows are joined installment > contract > application through installment.contract, then contract.application (The approved application that led to this contract).

WITH "m_approved_application_count" AS (
  SELECT
    "t1"."is_active" AS "branch__is_active",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE) AS "customer__birth_year",
    COUNT(*) AS "approved_application_count",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "t2"."customer_id") AS "__records_customer"
  FROM "lending"."core"."loan_applications" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."branches" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."cab_id" = "t1"."branch_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t2"
    ON "t0"."cust_id" = "t2"."customer_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."sts_putusan" = 'approved'
    )
  GROUP BY
    "t1"."is_active",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE)
), "m_decided_application_count" AS (
  SELECT
    "t1"."is_active" AS "branch__is_active",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE) AS "customer__birth_year",
    COUNT(*) AS "decided_application_count",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "t2"."customer_id") AS "__records_customer"
  FROM "lending"."core"."loan_applications" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."branches" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."cab_id" = "t1"."branch_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t2"
    ON "t0"."cust_id" = "t2"."customer_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."sts_putusan" IN ('approved', 'rejected')
    )
  GROUP BY
    "t1"."is_active",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE)
), "unioned" AS (
  SELECT
    "branch__is_active",
    "customer__birth_year",
    "approved_application_count",
    NULL AS "decided_application_count",
    "__records_customer"
  FROM "m_approved_application_count"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "branch__is_active",
    "customer__birth_year",
    NULL AS "approved_application_count",
    "decided_application_count",
    "__records_customer"
  FROM "m_decided_application_count"
), "combined" AS (
  SELECT
    "branch__is_active",
    "customer__birth_year",
    COALESCE(MAX("approved_application_count"), 0) AS "approved_application_count",
    COALESCE(MAX("decided_application_count"), 0) AS "decided_application_count",
    MIN("__records_customer") AS "__records_customer"
  FROM "unioned"
  GROUP BY
    "branch__is_active",
    "customer__birth_year"
)
SELECT
  "branch__is_active",
  "customer__birth_year",
  "approved_application_count",
  "decided_application_count",
  CAST("approved_application_count" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF("decided_application_count", 0) AS "approval_rate",
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM "combined"
    WHERE
      "__records_customer" < 10
  ) AS "__groups_left_out"
FROM "combined"
WHERE
  "__records_customer" >= 10
ORDER BY
  "branch__is_active",
  "customer__birth_year"
LIMIT 1000

The number of groups left out is in the result column __groups_left_out, the same on every row. A result with no rows can mean that every group was left out.
explanation: Approval Rate = Approved Application Count divided by Decided Application Count. Each side is calculated separately and then combined by is active and birth year; a zero denominator gives no value (empty), not an error.
Approved Application Count: Loan Application rows are placed by decision date (application.decision_date), with no limit on time.
Decided Application Count: Loan Application rows are placed by decision date (application.decision_date), with no limit on time.
Approved Application Count: only rows where sts_putusan = 'approved' count (part of the measure definition).
Decided Application Count: only rows where sts_putusan IN ('approved', 'rejected') count (part of the measure definition).

Is active (branch.is_active) comes from Branch: for Approved Application Count and Decided Application Count, rows are joined application > branch through application.branch (The branch that received the application. Used for origination metrics that count applications).

Birth year (customer.birth_year) comes from Customer: for Approved Application Count and Decided Application Count, rows are joined application > customer through application.customer (The customer who applied).
Birth year (customer.birth_year) is personal data, so it is masked: the date is cut to the first day of its year (truncate_date).

WITH "m_npf_outstanding_principal" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE) AS "customer__birth_year",
    SUM("t0"."outstanding_principal") AS "npf_outstanding_principal",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "t2"."customer_id") AS "__records_customer"
  FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."contract_id" = "t1"."contract_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t2"
    ON "t1"."customer_id" = "t2"."customer_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."days_past_due" > 90
    )
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" IN (
      SELECT
        MAX("s0"."snapshot_date")
      FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "s0"
    )
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE)
), "m_outstanding_principal" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE) AS "customer__birth_year",
    SUM("t0"."outstanding_principal") AS "outstanding_principal",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "t2"."customer_id") AS "__records_customer"
  FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."contract_id" = "t1"."contract_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t2"
    ON "t1"."customer_id" = "t2"."customer_id"
  WHERE
    "t0"."snapshot_date" IN (
      SELECT
        MAX("s0"."snapshot_date")
      FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "s0"
    )
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE)
), "unioned" AS (
  SELECT
    "customer__birth_year",
    "npf_outstanding_principal",
    NULL AS "outstanding_principal",
    "__records_customer"
  FROM "m_npf_outstanding_principal"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "customer__birth_year",
    NULL AS "npf_outstanding_principal",
    "outstanding_principal",
    "__records_customer"
  FROM "m_outstanding_principal"
), "combined" AS (
  SELECT
    "customer__birth_year",
    COALESCE(MAX("npf_outstanding_principal"), 0) AS "npf_outstanding_principal",
    COALESCE(MAX("outstanding_principal"), 0) AS "outstanding_principal",
    MIN("__records_customer") AS "__records_customer"
  FROM "unioned"
  GROUP BY
    "customer__birth_year"
)
SELECT
  "customer__birth_year",
  "npf_outstanding_principal",
  "outstanding_principal",
  CAST("npf_outstanding_principal" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF("outstanding_principal", 0) AS "npf_ratio",
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM "combined"
    WHERE
      "__records_customer" < 10
  ) AS "__groups_left_out"
FROM "combined"
WHERE
  "__records_customer" >= 10
ORDER BY
  "customer__birth_year"
LIMIT 1000
warnings: NPF Outstanding Principal is a balance: the value is the balance at the latest snapshot date in the time range, and balances are never added up across dates.
Outstanding Principal is a balance: the value is the balance at the latest snapshot date in the time range, and balances are never added up across dates.

NPF Outstanding Principal: Contract Month-End Position rows are placed by snapshot date (contract_snapshot.snapshot_date), with no limit on time.
Outstanding Principal: Contract Month-End Position rows are placed by snapshot date (contract_snapshot.snapshot_date), with no limit on time.

  FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "t0"
  WHERE
    "t0"."snapshot_date" >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)

        CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "s0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE)
    )

), "unioned" AS (

WITH "m_promise_to_pay_count" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."tgl_aksi") AS DATE) AS "metric_time",
    "t1"."maturity_date" AS "contract__maturity_date",
    "t1"."signed_date" AS "contract__signed_date",
    COUNT(*) AS "promise_to_pay_count"
  FROM "lending"."core"."collection_actions" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."kontrak_id" = "t1"."contract_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."loan_applications" AS "t2"
    ON "t1"."application_id" = "t2"."appl_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."hasil" = 'promise_to_pay'
    )
    AND "t2"."saluran" <> 'telesales'
    AND "t0"."tgl_aksi" >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."tgl_aksi" < CAST('2026-12-31' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."tgl_aksi") AS DATE),
    "t1"."maturity_date",
    "t1"."signed_date"
), "m_collection_action_count" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."tgl_aksi") AS DATE) AS "metric_time",
    "t1"."maturity_date" AS "contract__maturity_date",
    "t1"."signed_date" AS "contract__signed_date",
    COUNT(*) AS "collection_action_count"
  FROM "lending"."core"."collection_actions" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."kontrak_id" = "t1"."contract_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."loan_applications" AS "t2"
    ON "t1"."application_id" = "t2"."appl_id"
  WHERE
    "t2"."saluran" <> 'telesales'
    AND "t0"."tgl_aksi" >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."tgl_aksi" < CAST('2026-12-31' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."tgl_aksi") AS DATE),
    "t1"."maturity_date",
    "t1"."signed_date"
), "unioned" AS (
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "contract__maturity_date",
    "contract__signed_date",
    "promise_to_pay_count",
    NULL AS "collection_action_count"
  FROM "m_promise_to_pay_count"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "contract__maturity_date",
    "contract__signed_date",
    NULL AS "promise_to_pay_count",
    "collection_action_count"
  FROM "m_collection_action_count"
), "combined" AS (
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "contract__maturity_date",
    "contract__signed_date",
    COALESCE(MAX("promise_to_pay_count"), 0) AS "promise_to_pay_count",
    COALESCE(MAX("collection_action_count"), 0) AS "collection_action_count"
  FROM "unioned"
  GROUP BY
    "metric_time",
    "contract__maturity_date",
    "contract__signed_date"
)
SELECT
  "metric_time",
  "contract__maturity_date",
  "contract__signed_date",
  "promise_to_pay_count",
  "collection_action_count",
  CAST("promise_to_pay_count" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF("collection_action_count", 0) AS "promise_to_pay_rate"
FROM "combined"
ORDER BY
  "metric_time",
  "contract__maturity_date",
  "contract__signed_date"
LIMIT 1000
explanation: Promise to Pay Rate = Promise to Pay Count divided by Collection Action Count. Each side is calculated separately and then combined by quarter, maturity date and signed date; a zero denominator gives no value (empty), not an error.
Promise to Pay Count: Collection Action rows are placed by action date (collection_action.action_date), from 2025-01-01 up to but not including 2026-12-31, grouped by quarter.
Collection Action Count: Collection Action rows are placed by action date (collection_action.action_date), from 2025-01-01 up to but not including 2026-12-31, grouped by quarter.

WITH "m_restructured_outstanding_principal" AS (

  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t2"
    ON "t1"."customer_id" = "t2"."customer_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t1"."is_restructured"
    )
    AND "t2"."province" IN ('x', 'x')
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" < CAST('2026-12-31' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" IN (
      SELECT
        MAX("s0"."snapshot_date")
      FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "s0"
      WHERE
        "s0"."snapshot_date" >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
        AND "s0"."snapshot_date" < CAST('2026-12-31' AS DATE)
      GROUP BY
        CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "s0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE),
    "t1"."is_restructured",
    "t2"."occupation_group",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE)
), "m_outstanding_principal" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE) AS "metric_time",
    "t1"."is_restructured" AS "contract__is_restructured",
    "t2"."occupation_group" AS "customer__occupation_group",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE) AS "customer__birth_year",
    SUM("t0"."outstanding_principal") AS "outstanding_principal",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "t2"."customer_id") AS "__records_customer"
  FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."contract_id" = "t1"."contract_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t2"
    ON "t1"."customer_id" = "t2"."customer_id"
  WHERE
    "t2"."province" IN ('x', 'x')
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" < CAST('2026-12-31' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" IN (
      SELECT
        MAX("s0"."snapshot_date")
      FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "s0"
      WHERE
        "s0"."snapshot_date" >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
        AND "s0"."snapshot_date" < CAST('2026-12-31' AS DATE)
      GROUP BY
        CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "s0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE),
    "t1"."is_restructured",
    "t2"."occupation_group",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE)
), "unioned" AS (
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "contract__is_restructured",
    "customer__occupation_group",
    "customer__birth_year",
    "restructured_outstanding_principal",
    NULL AS "outstanding_principal",
    "__records_customer"
  FROM "m_restructured_outstanding_principal"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "contract__is_restructured",
    "customer__occupation_group",
    "customer__birth_year",
    NULL AS "restructured_outstanding_principal",
    "outstanding_principal",
    "__records_customer"

), "combined" AS (
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "contract__is_restructured",
    "customer__occupation_group",
    "customer__birth_year",
    COALESCE(MAX("restructured_outstanding_principal"), 0) AS "restructured_outstanding_principal",

  FROM "unioned"
  GROUP BY
    "metric_time",
    "contract__is_restructured",
    "customer__occupation_group",
    "customer__birth_year"
)
SELECT

  "contract__is_restructured",

  "customer__birth_year",

  "outstanding_principal",

  FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"

  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t2"
    ON "t1"."customer_id" = "t2"."customer_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t1"."is_restructured"
    )
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" IN (
      SELECT
        MAX("s0"."snapshot_date")
      FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "s0"
      GROUP BY
        CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "s0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE),
    "t1"."disbursement_date",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE)
), "m_outstanding_principal" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE) AS "metric_time",
    "t1"."disbursement_date" AS "contract__disbursement_date",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE) AS "customer__birth_year",
    SUM("t0"."outstanding_principal") AS "outstanding_principal",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "t2"."customer_id") AS "__records_customer"
  FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."contract_id" = "t1"."contract_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t2"
    ON "t1"."customer_id" = "t2"."customer_id"
  WHERE
    "t0"."snapshot_date" IN (
      SELECT
        MAX("s0"."snapshot_date")
      FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "s0"
      GROUP BY
        CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "s0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE),
    "t1"."disbursement_date",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE)

  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "contract__disbursement_date",
    "customer__birth_year",
    "restructured_outstanding_principal",
    NULL AS "outstanding_principal",

  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "contract__disbursement_date",
    "customer__birth_year",
    NULL AS "restructured_outstanding_principal",
    "outstanding_principal",
    "__records_customer"

  SELECT
    "metric_time",

    COALESCE(MAX("outstanding_principal"), 0) AS "outstanding_principal",
    MIN("__records_customer") AS "__records_customer"
  FROM "unioned"
  GROUP BY
    "metric_time",
    "contract__disbursement_date",
    "customer__birth_year"
)
SELECT
  "metric_time",
  "contract__disbursement_date",
  "customer__birth_year",

    WHERE
      "__records_customer" < 10
  ) AS "__groups_left_out"
FROM "combined"
WHERE
  "__records_customer" >= 10
ORDER BY
  "metric_time",
  "contract__disbursement_date",
  "customer__birth_year"
LIMIT 1000

  FROM "unioned"
)

  "collection_action_count",

  FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."contract_id" = "t1"."contract_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t2"
    ON "t1"."customer_id" = "t2"."customer_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t1"."is_restructured"
    )
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" IN (
      SELECT
        MAX("s0"."snapshot_date")
      FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "s0"

    "t0"."dpd_bucket",
    "t1"."tenor_months",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE)
), "m_outstanding_principal" AS (
  SELECT
    "t0"."dpd_bucket" AS "contract_snapshot__dpd_bucket",
    "t1"."tenor_months" AS "contract__tenor_months",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE) AS "customer__birth_year",

  FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"

  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t2"

  WHERE
    "t0"."snapshot_date" IN (
      SELECT
        MAX("s0"."snapshot_date")
      FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "s0"
    )
  GROUP BY
    "t0"."dpd_bucket",
    "t1"."tenor_months",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE)
), "unioned" AS (
  SELECT
    "contract_snapshot__dpd_bucket",
    "contract__tenor_months",
    "customer__birth_year",
    "restructured_outstanding_principal",
    NULL AS "outstanding_principal",
    "__records_customer"
  FROM "m_restructured_outstanding_principal"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "contract_snapshot__dpd_bucket",
    "contract__tenor_months",
    "customer__birth_year",
    NULL AS "restructured_outstanding_principal",
    "outstanding_principal",
    "__records_customer"
  FROM "m_outstanding_principal"
), "combined" AS (
  SELECT

    "contract__tenor_months",

    COALESCE(MAX("restructured_outstanding_principal"), 0) AS "restructured_outstanding_principal",
    COALESCE(MAX("outstanding_principal"), 0) AS "outstanding_principal",
    MIN("__records_customer") AS "__records_customer"

SELECT

FROM "combined"

WITH "m_approved_application_count" AS (
  SELECT

    ON "t0"."cust_id" = "t1"."customer_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."products" AS "t2"
    ON "t0"."prod_id" = "t2"."product_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."sts_putusan" = 'approved'
    )
    AND "t0"."tgl_putusan" >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."tgl_putusan" < CAST('2026-12-31' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    "t1"."city",
    "t2"."product_category",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t1"."birth_date") AS DATE)
), "m_decided_application_count" AS (
  SELECT

  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."sts_putusan" IN ('approved', 'rejected')
    )
    AND "t0"."tgl_putusan" >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."tgl_putusan" < CAST('2026-12-31' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    "t1"."city",
    "t2"."product_category",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t1"."birth_date") AS DATE)

  SELECT
    "customer__city",

    MIN("__records_customer") AS "__records_customer"
  FROM "unioned"
  GROUP BY
    "customer__city",
    "product__product_category",
    "customer__birth_year"
)

  "t1"."area_name" AS "branch__area_name",
  "t0"."restructured_date" AS "contract__restructured_date",

FROM "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t0"
LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."branches" AS "t1"

WHERE

  AND "t1"."area_name" = 'Java'

GROUP BY
  CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "t0"."disbursement_date") AS DATE),
  "t1"."area_name",
  "t0"."restructured_date"
ORDER BY
  "metric_time",
  "branch__area_name",
  "contract__restructured_date"
LIMIT 1000

WITH "m_disbursement_amount" AS (
  SELECT
    "t0"."closed_date" AS "contract__closed_date",
    SUM("t0"."principal_amount") AS "disbursement_amount"
  FROM "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t0"
  WHERE
    (
      NOT "t0"."disbursement_date" IS NULL
    )
    AND "t0"."disbursement_date" >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."disbursement_date" < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    "t0"."closed_date"
), "m_disbursed_contract_count" AS (
  SELECT
    "t0"."closed_date" AS "contract__closed_date",
    COUNT(*) AS "disbursed_contract_count"
  FROM "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t0"
  WHERE
    (
      NOT "t0"."disbursement_date" IS NULL
    )
    AND "t0"."disbursement_date" >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."disbursement_date" < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    "t0"."closed_date"
), "unioned" AS (
  SELECT
    "contract__closed_date",
    "disbursement_amount",
    NULL AS "disbursed_contract_count"
  FROM "m_disbursement_amount"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "contract__closed_date",
    NULL AS "disbursement_amount",
    "disbursed_contract_count"
  FROM "m_disbursed_contract_count"
), "combined" AS (
  SELECT
    "contract__closed_date",
    COALESCE(MAX("disbursement_amount"), 0) AS "disbursement_amount",
    COALESCE(MAX("disbursed_contract_count"), 0) AS "disbursed_contract_count"
  FROM "unioned"
  GROUP BY
    "contract__closed_date"
)
SELECT
  "contract__closed_date",
  "disbursement_amount",
  "disbursed_contract_count",
  CAST("disbursement_amount" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF("disbursed_contract_count", 0) AS "average_ticket_size"
FROM "combined"
ORDER BY
  "contract__closed_date"
LIMIT 1000
explanation: Average Ticket Size = Disbursement Amount divided by Disbursed Contract Count. Each side is calculated separately and then combined by closed date; a zero denominator gives no value (empty), not an error.
Disbursement Amount: Financing Contract rows are placed by disbursement date (contract.disbursement_date), from 2026-01-01 up to but not including 2026-07-01.
Disbursed Contract Count: Financing Contract rows are placed by disbursement date (contract.disbursement_date), from 2026-01-01 up to but not including 2026-07-01.
Disbursement Amount: only rows where disbursement_date IS NOT NULL count (part of the measure definition).
Disbursed Contract Count: only rows where disbursement_date IS NOT NULL count (part of the measure definition).

WITH "m_par30_outstanding_principal" AS (

    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE) AS "customer__birth_year",

  FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"

  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t2"
    ON "t1"."customer_id" = "t2"."customer_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."days_past_due" > 30

    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" IN (

        MAX("s0"."snapshot_date")
      FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "s0"
      GROUP BY
        CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "s0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE),
    "t2"."city",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE)
), "m_outstanding_principal" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE) AS "metric_time",
    "t2"."city" AS "customer__city",

  FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."contract_id" = "t1"."contract_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t2"
    ON "t1"."customer_id" = "t2"."customer_id"
  WHERE
    "t0"."snapshot_date" IN (
      SELECT
        MAX("s0"."snapshot_date")
      FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "s0"
      GROUP BY
        CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "s0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE),
    "t2"."city",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE)

  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "customer__city",
    "customer__birth_year",
    "par30_outstanding_principal",
    NULL AS "outstanding_principal",
    "__records_customer"
  FROM "m_par30_outstanding_principal"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "customer__city",
    "customer__birth_year",
    NULL AS "par30_outstanding_principal",
    "outstanding_principal",
    "__records_customer"

  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "customer__city",
    "customer__birth_year",
    COALESCE(MAX("par30_outstanding_principal"), 0) AS "par30_outstanding_principal",
    COALESCE(MAX("outstanding_principal"), 0) AS "outstanding_principal",
    MIN("__records_customer") AS "__records_customer"

  GROUP BY

    "customer__birth_year"
)

  "customer__city",
  "customer__birth_year",

FROM "combined"
WHERE
  "__records_customer" >= 10
ORDER BY
  "metric_time",
  "customer__city",
  "customer__birth_year"
LIMIT 1000

WITH "m_collected_amount" AS (
  SELECT
    SUM("t0"."principal_paid" + "t0"."interest_paid") AS "collected_amount"
  FROM "lending"."core"."payments" AS "t0"
  WHERE
    (
      NOT "t0"."is_reversed"
    )
), "m_due_amount" AS (
  SELECT
    SUM("t0"."installment_amount") AS "due_amount"
  FROM "lending"."core"."installment_schedules" AS "t0"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."is_current"
    )
), "unioned" AS (
  SELECT
    "collected_amount",
    NULL AS "due_amount"
  FROM "m_collected_amount"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    NULL AS "collected_amount",
    "due_amount"
  FROM "m_due_amount"
), "combined" AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(MAX("collected_amount"), 0) AS "collected_amount",
    COALESCE(MAX("due_amount"), 0) AS "due_amount"
  FROM "unioned"
)
SELECT
  "collected_amount",
  "due_amount",
  CAST("collected_amount" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF("due_amount", 0) AS "collection_rate"
FROM "combined"
LIMIT 1000

    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)

    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" IN (
      SELECT

      WHERE
        "s0"."snapshot_date" >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)

      GROUP BY
        CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "s0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE),
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE)
), "m_outstanding_principal" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE) AS "metric_time",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE) AS "customer__birth_year",
    SUM("t0"."outstanding_principal") AS "outstanding_principal",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "t2"."customer_id") AS "__records_customer"
  FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."contract_id" = "t1"."contract_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t2"
    ON "t1"."customer_id" = "t2"."customer_id"
  WHERE
    "t1"."signed_date" <> CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" IN (
      SELECT
        MAX("s0"."snapshot_date")
      FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "s0"
      WHERE
        "s0"."snapshot_date" >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
        AND "s0"."snapshot_date" < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)
      GROUP BY
        CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "s0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE),
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE)
), "unioned" AS (
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "customer__birth_year",
    "par30_outstanding_principal",
    NULL AS "outstanding_principal",
    "__records_customer"

    "customer__birth_year"

  "customer__birth_year",
  "par30_outstanding_principal",

  (
    SELECT

FROM "combined"
WHERE
  "__records_customer" >= 10

    "promise_to_pay_count",
    NULL AS "collection_action_count",
    "__records_customer"

  "__records_customer" >= 10

WITH "m_approved_application_count" AS (
  SELECT
    "t0"."saluran" AS "application__channel",
    "t1"."branch_name" AS "branch__branch_name",
    COUNT(*) AS "approved_application_count"
  FROM "lending"."core"."loan_applications" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."branches" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."cab_id" = "t1"."branch_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."sts_putusan" = 'approved'
    )
  GROUP BY
    "t0"."saluran",
    "t1"."branch_name"
), "m_decided_application_count" AS (
  SELECT
    "t0"."saluran" AS "application__channel",
    "t1"."branch_name" AS "branch__branch_name",
    COUNT(*) AS "decided_application_count"
  FROM "lending"."core"."loan_applications" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."branches" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."cab_id" = "t1"."branch_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."sts_putusan" IN ('approved', 'rejected')
    )
  GROUP BY
    "t0"."saluran",
    "t1"."branch_name"
), "unioned" AS (
  SELECT
    "application__channel",
    "branch__branch_name",
    "approved_application_count",
    NULL AS "decided_application_count"
  FROM "m_approved_application_count"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "application__channel",
    "branch__branch_name",
    NULL AS "approved_application_count",
    "decided_application_count"
  FROM "m_decided_application_count"
), "combined" AS (
  SELECT
    "application__channel",
    "branch__branch_name",
    COALESCE(MAX("approved_application_count"), 0) AS "approved_application_count",
    COALESCE(MAX("decided_application_count"), 0) AS "decided_application_count"
  FROM "unioned"
  GROUP BY
    "application__channel",
    "branch__branch_name"
)
SELECT
  "application__channel",
  "branch__branch_name",
  "approved_application_count",
  "decided_application_count",
  CAST("approved_application_count" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF("decided_application_count", 0) AS "approval_rate"
FROM "combined"
ORDER BY
  "application__channel",
  "branch__branch_name"
LIMIT 1000
explanation: Approval Rate = Approved Application Count divided by Decided Application Count. Each side is calculated separately and then combined by channel and branch name; a zero denominator gives no value (empty), not an error.

Decided Application Count: Loan Application rows are placed by decision date (application.decision_date), with no limit on time.
Approved Application Count: only rows where sts_putusan = 'approved' count (part of the measure definition).
Decided Application Count: only rows where sts_putusan IN ('approved', 'rejected') count (part of the measure definition).

Branch name (branch.branch_name) comes from Branch: for Approved Application Count and Decided Application Count, rows are joined application > branch through application.branch (The branch that received the application. Used for origination metrics that count applications).

WITH "m_par30_outstanding_principal" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE) AS "metric_time",
    "t2"."province" AS "branch__province",
    "t1"."restructured_date" AS "contract__restructured_date",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t3"."birth_date") AS DATE) AS "customer__birth_year",
    SUM("t0"."outstanding_principal") AS "par30_outstanding_principal",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "t3"."customer_id") AS "__records_customer"
  FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."contract_id" = "t1"."contract_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."branches" AS "t2"
    ON "t1"."servicing_branch_id" = "t2"."branch_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t3"
    ON "t1"."customer_id" = "t3"."customer_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."days_past_due" > 30
    )
    AND "t3"."income_band" = 'lt_5m'
    AND "t2"."province" = 'x'
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" IN (
      SELECT
        MAX("s0"."snapshot_date")
      FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "s0"
      GROUP BY
        CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "s0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE),
    "t2"."province",
    "t1"."restructured_date",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t3"."birth_date") AS DATE)
), "m_outstanding_principal" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE) AS "metric_time",
    "t2"."province" AS "branch__province",
    "t1"."restructured_date" AS "contract__restructured_date",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t3"."birth_date") AS DATE) AS "customer__birth_year",
    SUM("t0"."outstanding_principal") AS "outstanding_principal",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "t3"."customer_id") AS "__records_customer"
  FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."contract_id" = "t1"."contract_id"

  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t3"

  WHERE
    "t3"."income_band" = 'lt_5m'
    AND "t2"."province" = 'x'
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" IN (
      SELECT
        MAX("s0"."snapshot_date")
      FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "s0"
      GROUP BY
        CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "s0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE),
    "t2"."province",
    "t1"."restructured_date",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t3"."birth_date") AS DATE)
), "unioned" AS (
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "branch__province",
    "contract__restructured_date",
    "customer__birth_year",
    "par30_outstanding_principal",
    NULL AS "outstanding_principal",
    "__records_customer"
  FROM "m_par30_outstanding_principal"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "branch__province",
    "contract__restructured_date",
    "customer__birth_year",

    "branch__province",
    "contract__restructured_date",
    "customer__birth_year"

FROM "combined"
WHERE

ORDER BY

WITH "m_approved_application_count" AS (

  FROM "lending"."core"."loan_applications" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."cust_id" = "t1"."customer_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."branches" AS "t2"
    ON "t0"."cab_id" = "t2"."branch_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."products" AS "t3"
    ON "t0"."prod_id" = "t3"."product_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."sts_putusan" = 'approved'
    )
    AND "t1"."customer_segment" IS NULL
    AND "t0"."tgl_putusan" >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."tgl_putusan" < CAST('2026-12-31' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    "t1"."occupation_group",
    "t2"."is_active",
    "t3"."product_name"
), "m_decided_application_count" AS (
  SELECT
    "t1"."occupation_group" AS "customer__occupation_group",
    "t2"."is_active" AS "branch__is_active",
    "t3"."product_name" AS "product__product_name",
    COUNT(*) AS "decided_application_count"
  FROM "lending"."core"."loan_applications" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."cust_id" = "t1"."customer_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."branches" AS "t2"
    ON "t0"."cab_id" = "t2"."branch_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."products" AS "t3"
    ON "t0"."prod_id" = "t3"."product_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."sts_putusan" IN ('approved', 'rejected')
    )
    AND "t1"."customer_segment" IS NULL
    AND "t0"."tgl_putusan" >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."tgl_putusan" < CAST('2026-12-31' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    "t1"."occupation_group",
    "t2"."is_active",
    "t3"."product_name"
), "unioned" AS (
  SELECT
    "customer__occupation_group",
    "branch__is_active",
    "product__product_name",
    "approved_application_count",
    NULL AS "decided_application_count"
  FROM "m_approved_application_count"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "customer__occupation_group",
    "branch__is_active",
    "product__product_name",
    NULL AS "approved_application_count",
    "decided_application_count"
  FROM "m_decided_application_count"
), "combined" AS (
  SELECT
    "customer__occupation_group",
    "branch__is_active",
    "product__product_name",
    COALESCE(MAX("approved_application_count"), 0) AS "approved_application_count",
    COALESCE(MAX("decided_application_count"), 0) AS "decided_application_count"
  FROM "unioned"
  GROUP BY
    "customer__occupation_group",
    "branch__is_active",
    "product__product_name"
)
SELECT
  "customer__occupation_group",
  "branch__is_active",
  "product__product_name",
  "approved_application_count",
  "decided_application_count",
  CAST("approved_application_count" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF("decided_application_count", 0) AS "approval_rate"
FROM "combined"
ORDER BY
  "customer__occupation_group",
  "branch__is_active",
  "product__product_name"
LIMIT 1000

  SELECT

  SELECT

WITH "m_approved_application_count" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."tgl_putusan") AS DATE) AS "metric_time",
    "t1"."province" AS "branch__province",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE) AS "customer__birth_year",
    COUNT(*) AS "approved_application_count",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "t2"."customer_id") AS "__records_customer"
  FROM "lending"."core"."loan_applications" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."branches" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."cab_id" = "t1"."branch_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t2"
    ON "t0"."cust_id" = "t2"."customer_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."sts_putusan" = 'approved'
    )
    AND "t2"."occupation_group" IN ('self_employed', 'professional')
    AND "t0"."tgl_putusan" >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."tgl_putusan" < CAST('2026-12-31' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."tgl_putusan") AS DATE),
    "t1"."province",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE)
), "m_decided_application_count" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."tgl_putusan") AS DATE) AS "metric_time",
    "t1"."province" AS "branch__province",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE) AS "customer__birth_year",
    COUNT(*) AS "decided_application_count",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "t2"."customer_id") AS "__records_customer"
  FROM "lending"."core"."loan_applications" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."branches" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."cab_id" = "t1"."branch_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t2"
    ON "t0"."cust_id" = "t2"."customer_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."sts_putusan" IN ('approved', 'rejected')
    )
    AND "t2"."occupation_group" IN ('self_employed', 'professional')
    AND "t0"."tgl_putusan" >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."tgl_putusan" < CAST('2026-12-31' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."tgl_putusan") AS DATE),
    "t1"."province",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE)
), "unioned" AS (
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "branch__province",
    "customer__birth_year",
    "approved_application_count",
    NULL AS "decided_application_count",
    "__records_customer"
  FROM "m_approved_application_count"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "branch__province",
    "customer__birth_year",
    NULL AS "approved_application_count",
    "decided_application_count",
    "__records_customer"
  FROM "m_decided_application_count"
), "combined" AS (
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "branch__province",
    "customer__birth_year",
    COALESCE(MAX("approved_application_count"), 0) AS "approved_application_count",
    COALESCE(MAX("decided_application_count"), 0) AS "decided_application_count",
    MIN("__records_customer") AS "__records_customer"
  FROM "unioned"
  GROUP BY
    "metric_time",
    "branch__province",
    "customer__birth_year"
)
SELECT
  "metric_time",
  "branch__province",
  "customer__birth_year",
  "approved_application_count",
  "decided_application_count",
  CAST("approved_application_count" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF("decided_application_count", 0) AS "approval_rate",
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM "combined"
    WHERE
      "__records_customer" < 10
  ) AS "__groups_left_out"
FROM "combined"
WHERE
  "__records_customer" >= 10
ORDER BY
  "metric_time",
  "branch__province",
  "customer__birth_year"
LIMIT 1000

), "m_outstanding_principal" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE) AS "metric_time",
    SUM("t0"."outstanding_principal") AS "outstanding_principal"
  FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "t0"
  WHERE
    "t0"."snapshot_date" IN (
      SELECT
        MAX("s0"."snapshot_date")

  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    NULL AS "restructured_outstanding_principal",

  FROM "m_outstanding_principal"
), "combined" AS (

    "metric_time",

WITH "m_approved_application_count" AS (
  SELECT

    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "t0"."tgl_putusan") AS DATE),
    "t0"."grade_risiko"
), "m_decided_application_count" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "t0"."tgl_putusan") AS DATE) AS "metric_time",
    "t0"."grade_risiko" AS "application__risk_grade",
    COUNT(*) AS "decided_application_count"
  FROM "lending"."core"."loan_applications" AS "t0"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."sts_putusan" IN ('approved', 'rejected')
    )
    AND "t0"."tgl_putusan" >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."tgl_putusan" < CAST('2026-12-31' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "t0"."tgl_putusan") AS DATE),
    "t0"."grade_risiko"
), "unioned" AS (
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "application__risk_grade",
    "approved_application_count",
    NULL AS "decided_application_count"
  FROM "m_approved_application_count"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "application__risk_grade",
    NULL AS "approved_application_count",
    "decided_application_count"
  FROM "m_decided_application_count"
), "combined" AS (
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "application__risk_grade",
    COALESCE(MAX("approved_application_count"), 0) AS "approved_application_count",
    COALESCE(MAX("decided_application_count"), 0) AS "decided_application_count"
  FROM "unioned"

)

  "decided_application_count",
  CAST("approved_application_count" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF("decided_application_count", 0) AS "approval_rate"
FROM "combined"
ORDER BY
  "metric_time",
  "application__risk_grade"

  WHERE
    (
      NOT "t0"."is_reversed"
    )
    AND "t2"."branch_code" IN ('Java', 'Java')

  GROUP BY
    "t2"."branch_name"

    ON "t0"."contract_id" = "t1"."contract_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."branches" AS "t2"

  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."loan_applications" AS "t3"
    ON "t1"."application_id" = "t3"."appl_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."is_current"
    )
    AND "t2"."branch_code" IN ('Java', 'Java')

  GROUP BY
    "t2"."branch_name"
), "unioned" AS (
  SELECT

    "collected_amount",
    NULL AS "due_amount"
  FROM "m_collected_amount"
  UNION ALL

    "branch__branch_name",

    "due_amount"
  FROM "m_due_amount"
), "combined" AS (

)

WITH "m_collected_amount" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST("t2"."tgl_pengajuan" AS DATE) AS "application__submitted_date",
    SUM("t0"."principal_paid" + "t0"."interest_paid") AS "collected_amount"
  FROM "lending"."core"."payments" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."contract_id" = "t1"."contract_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."loan_applications" AS "t2"
    ON "t1"."application_id" = "t2"."appl_id"
  WHERE
    (
      NOT "t0"."is_reversed"
    )
  GROUP BY
    CAST("t2"."tgl_pengajuan" AS DATE)
), "m_due_amount" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST("t2"."tgl_pengajuan" AS DATE) AS "application__submitted_date",
    SUM("t0"."installment_amount") AS "due_amount"
  FROM "lending"."core"."installment_schedules" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."contract_id" = "t1"."contract_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."loan_applications" AS "t2"
    ON "t1"."application_id" = "t2"."appl_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."is_current"
    )
  GROUP BY
    CAST("t2"."tgl_pengajuan" AS DATE)
), "unioned" AS (
  SELECT
    "application__submitted_date",
    "collected_amount",
    NULL AS "due_amount"
  FROM "m_collected_amount"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "application__submitted_date",
    NULL AS "collected_amount",
    "due_amount"
  FROM "m_due_amount"
), "combined" AS (
  SELECT
    "application__submitted_date",
    COALESCE(MAX("collected_amount"), 0) AS "collected_amount",
    COALESCE(MAX("due_amount"), 0) AS "due_amount"
  FROM "unioned"
  GROUP BY
    "application__submitted_date"
)
SELECT
  "application__submitted_date",
  "collected_amount",
  "due_amount",
  CAST("collected_amount" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF("due_amount", 0) AS "collection_rate"
FROM "combined"
ORDER BY
  "application__submitted_date"
LIMIT 1000

WITH "m_collected_amount" AS (

WITH "m_approved_application_count" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t0"."tgl_putusan") AS DATE) AS "metric_time",
    "t1"."is_active" AS "branch__is_active",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE) AS "customer__birth_year",
    COUNT(*) AS "approved_application_count",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "t2"."customer_id") AS "__records_customer"
  FROM "lending"."core"."loan_applications" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."branches" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."cab_id" = "t1"."branch_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t2"
    ON "t0"."cust_id" = "t2"."customer_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."sts_putusan" = 'approved'
    )
    AND "t0"."tgl_putusan" <> CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."tgl_putusan" >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."tgl_putusan" < CAST('2026-12-31' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t0"."tgl_putusan") AS DATE),
    "t1"."is_active",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE)
), "m_decided_application_count" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t0"."tgl_putusan") AS DATE) AS "metric_time",
    "t1"."is_active" AS "branch__is_active",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE) AS "customer__birth_year",
    COUNT(*) AS "decided_application_count",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "t2"."customer_id") AS "__records_customer"
  FROM "lending"."core"."loan_applications" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."branches" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."cab_id" = "t1"."branch_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t2"
    ON "t0"."cust_id" = "t2"."customer_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."sts_putusan" IN ('approved', 'rejected')
    )
    AND "t0"."tgl_putusan" <> CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."tgl_putusan" >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."tgl_putusan" < CAST('2026-12-31' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t0"."tgl_putusan") AS DATE),
    "t1"."is_active",
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "t2"."birth_date") AS DATE)
), "unioned" AS (
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "branch__is_active",
    "customer__birth_year",
    "approved_application_count",
    NULL AS "decided_application_count",
    "__records_customer"
  FROM "m_approved_application_count"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "branch__is_active",
    "customer__birth_year",
    NULL AS "approved_application_count",
    "decided_application_count",
    "__records_customer"
  FROM "m_decided_application_count"
), "combined" AS (
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "branch__is_active",
    "customer__birth_year",
    COALESCE(MAX("approved_application_count"), 0) AS "approved_application_count",
    COALESCE(MAX("decided_application_count"), 0) AS "decided_application_count",
    MIN("__records_customer") AS "__records_customer"
  FROM "unioned"
  GROUP BY
    "metric_time",
    "branch__is_active",
    "customer__birth_year"
)
SELECT
  "metric_time",
  "branch__is_active",
  "customer__birth_year",
  "approved_application_count",
  "decided_application_count",
  CAST("approved_application_count" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF("decided_application_count", 0) AS "approval_rate",
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM "combined"
    WHERE
      "__records_customer" < 10
  ) AS "__groups_left_out"
FROM "combined"
WHERE
  "__records_customer" >= 10
ORDER BY
  "metric_time",
  "branch__is_active",
  "customer__birth_year"
LIMIT 1000
warnings: Groups built from fewer than 10 Customer records are left out of this result to protect personal data. This does not stop someone from comparing two requests that differ by one person. The number of groups left out is in the result column __groups_left_out, the same on every row. A result with no rows can mean that every group was left out.
explanation: Approval Rate = Approved Application Count divided by Decided Application Count. Each side is calculated separately and then combined by year, is active and birth year; a zero denominator gives no value (empty), not an error.
Approved Application Count: Loan Application rows are placed by decision date (application.decision_date), from 2025-01-01 up to but not including 2026-12-31, grouped by year.
Decided Application Count: Loan Application rows are placed by decision date (application.decision_date), from 2025-01-01 up to but not including 2026-12-31, grouped by year.
Approved Application Count: only rows where sts_putusan = 'approved' count (part of the measure definition).
Decided Application Count: only rows where sts_putusan IN ('approved', 'rejected') count (part of the measure definition).
The request keeps only rows where application.decision_date is not '2026-03-01'.

Is active (branch.is_active) comes from Branch: for Approved Application Count and Decided Application Count, rows are joined application > branch through application.branch (The branch that received the application. Used for origination metrics that count applications).

Birth year (customer.birth_year) comes from Customer: for Approved Application Count and Decided Application Count, rows are joined application > customer through application.customer (The customer who applied).
Birth year (customer.birth_year) is personal data, so it is masked: the date is cut to the first day of its year (truncate_date).
